metrics.label: Skills exercised
metrics.definition: Mapped graded tasks with at least one required step ticked, over mapped tasks.

metrics.label: Skills practised
metrics.definition: Skills with at least one ticked required step, over the skills the course maps.

metrics.label: Skills verified
metrics.definition: Skills with at least one verifiable step verified from pasted output, over skills with a verifiable step.

metrics.label: Skills fully verified
metrics.definition: Skills whose every verifiable step is verified, over skills with a verifiable step.

metrics.label: Skills reviewed
metrics.definition: Verified skills whose mapped deliverable the team had approved or issued, over verified skills.
metrics.note: A team fact: the document was approved, not the member alone. Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Next task per gap
metrics.definition: For each skill not started, the first mapped task not done, in course order.

metrics.label: Skills state-proven
metrics.definition: Skills confirmed by a validator that read the real system state, over skills.
metrics.note: A first validator parses pasted ufw output as state in the browser; results are not yet recorded, and a lab agent is Phase 2.

metrics.label: Skills attested
metrics.definition: Skills carried by a signed attestation with an environment hash, over skills.

metrics.label: Tools used
metrics.definition: Tools of tasks with at least one ticked required step, over the tools the course derives.

metrics.label: Tools verified
metrics.definition: Tools of tasks with at least one verified step, over tools used.

metrics.label: Commands verified per tool
metrics.definition: Verified steps whose command belongs to the tool, over verifiable steps with such a command.

metrics.label: Tools evidenced by file
metrics.definition: Hashed artifacts whose filename tool segment resolves to the tool, over hashed artifacts.

metrics.label: Commands copied per tool
metrics.definition: Copy or paste events per tool.

metrics.label: Procedures started
metrics.definition: SOP kinds with a mapped form holding data or a mapped task ticked, over the SOP kinds the course maps.
metrics.note: Form data is a team fact; loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Procedures followed
metrics.definition: SOP kinds whose mapped forms meet every Definition-of-Done check due and have document control complete, over started.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Procedures evidenced
metrics.definition: Followed SOP kinds whose evidence fields point at a hashed artifact, over followed.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Procedures to standard
metrics.definition: Followed SOP kinds whose form cites a parsed control code and was approved or issued, over followed.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Steps verified in order
metrics.definition: Tasks whose verifiable steps were verified in authored order, over tasks with two or more verification records. A sequence fact only.

metrics.label: Change rows with rollback
metrics.definition: Change-record rows with a rollback or back-out filled, over change rows on the forms of the role.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Custody rows hashed
metrics.definition: Custody-log rows whose digest matches a hashed artifact, over custody rows.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Drills completed
metrics.definition: Recovery and incident SOP kinds with the drill task verified and the record approved, over such SOP kinds.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Guide procedures followed
metrics.definition: Server+ guide procedures referenced by a ticked step, over guide procedures the role’s tasks reference.
metrics.note: Server+ only.

metrics.label: Backup before write
metrics.definition: Config writes preceded by their backup command, over config writes.
metrics.note: Steps are ticked as a whole; commands are not.

metrics.label: Procedures state-proven
metrics.definition: SOP outcomes read from system state by a validator, over followed.

metrics.label: Tactics practised
metrics.definition: ATT&CK or ATLAS tactics of tasks with at least one ticked step, over the tactics the course maps.

metrics.label: Tactics verified
metrics.definition: Tactics of tasks with at least one verified step, over tactics practised.

metrics.label: Technique ids cited
metrics.definition: Technique ids typed into forms that resolve to the matrices, over technique fields.
metrics.note: Team rows carry no author.

metrics.label: Practices practised
metrics.definition: Engineering practices of tasks with at least one ticked step, over the practices the course maps.

metrics.label: Practices verified
metrics.definition: Practices of tasks with at least one verified step, over practices practised.

metrics.label: Standards practised
metrics.definition: Standards tagged on tasks or steps the member ticked, over standards the course tags.

metrics.label: Standards verified
metrics.definition: Standards tagged on a verified step, over standards practised.

metrics.label: Effectiveness: steps
metrics.definition: Per standard: verified steps over verifiable steps tagged with it.

metrics.label: Effectiveness: forms
metrics.definition: Per standard: forms citing it approved with all four rubric categories true, over forms citing it.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Effectiveness: procedures
metrics.definition: Per standard: SOP kinds anchored to it followed, over SOP kinds anchored to it.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Controls cited
metrics.definition: Distinct control codes on approved forms the member’s role drafted.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Controls typed by member
metrics.definition: Control codes the member typed into form fields that parse, over such fields.
metrics.note: Team rows carry no author.

metrics.label: Domains practised
metrics.definition: Exam domains with at least one ticked task of the role, over domains the course practises.

metrics.label: Domains verified
metrics.definition: Exam domains with at least one verified step, over domains the course practises.

metrics.label: Exam weight verified
metrics.definition: Sum of the weights of verified domains over the weights the course practises.

metrics.label: Next task per domain gap
metrics.definition: The next task of the role that practises a domain not yet practised.

metrics.label: Domain recall
metrics.definition: A domain re-verified after a gap, over domains verified.

metrics.label: Steps verified
metrics.definition: Verified steps over verifiable required steps in graded weeks.

metrics.label: Steps self-attested
metrics.definition: Verifiable required steps ticked without matching output, over verifiable required steps.

metrics.label: Files hashed
metrics.definition: Distinct hashed files the member saved.

metrics.label: Files named to convention
metrics.definition: Hashed files named to the evidence convention, over hashed files.

metrics.label: Files re-hashed
metrics.definition: Files re-hashed later with the same digest, over hashed files.
metrics.note: The latest check per file counts. The file never leaves the browser.

metrics.label: Verified steps receipted
metrics.definition: Verified steps with a server receipt for a server-issued stamp, over verified steps.
metrics.note: Cloud mode only. A receipt records the stamp, not the machine.

metrics.label: Output proven on the lab
metrics.definition: Steps whose output was verified on the lab, not in the browser, over verified steps.

metrics.label: Forms drafted
metrics.definition: Lifecycle rows by the member moving a form to in review.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Forms reviewed
metrics.definition: Lifecycle rows by the member approving or returning a form.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Forms issued
metrics.definition: Lifecycle rows by the member issuing a form.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Submissions frozen
metrics.definition: Frozen submissions by the member.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Submissions rubric-green
metrics.definition: The member’s frozen submissions with all four rubric categories true, over the member’s submissions.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Definition-of-Done met
metrics.definition: Definition-of-Done checks met over checks due on the role’s forms through the current week.
metrics.note: A team fact; loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Document control complete
metrics.definition: Forms with the document-control block complete, over the role’s forms.
metrics.note: A team fact; loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Instructor approved
metrics.definition: The role’s forms with an instructor verdict of approved, over the role’s forms.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Teammate steps ticked
metrics.definition: Required steps the member ticked on another role’s tasks.

metrics.label: Hand-offs completed
metrics.definition: Hand-offs whose named deliverable reached approved or issued, over hand-offs of the role’s tasks.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: RACI respected
metrics.definition: Lifecycle transitions the member made in the role the RACI names, over the member’s transitions.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Peer reviews given
metrics.definition: Blind peer reviews the member completed, over reviews assigned to the member.
metrics.note: R136: counted from the queue every surface reads; offline both counts are zero.

metrics.label: Stuck flags helped
metrics.definition: Teammate stuck flags on steps the member had verified.
metrics.note: Current flags only; loads on the course page.

metrics.label: First-try verifications
metrics.definition: Verified steps with exactly one paste, over verified steps. Shown beside persistence, never alone.

metrics.label: Persistence
metrics.definition: Verified steps that took more than one paste, over verified steps.

metrics.label: Partial progress
metrics.definition: Verifiable steps with some tokens matched and not verified, over verifiable steps.

metrics.label: Reports filed
metrics.definition: Task reports the member filed, and how many were resolved.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Notes written
metrics.definition: Steps the member wrote a note on.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Independence
metrics.definition: Steps verified with no stuck flag ever raised, over verified steps.
metrics.note: R132: flag events keep the raise and the clear. Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Active days
metrics.definition: Distinct local days with recorded activity.

metrics.label: Active weeks
metrics.definition: Course weeks with any recorded activity, over graded weeks.

metrics.label: Retention
metrics.definition: Skills verified again on a later task seven or more days after the first, over skills verified.
metrics.note: R132: read from the stamps of verification records.

metrics.label: Calibration
metrics.definition: Stated confidence that matched the outcome, over stated confidences.

metrics.label: Fixes consulted
metrics.definition: "If it does not work" rows opened before a verification, over verifications.

metrics.label: Documentation opened
metrics.definition: Documentation links opened per task.

metrics.label: On time
metrics.definition: Tasks whose last verification fell on or before the week due date, over tasks verified; needs the cohort start date.
metrics.note: R132: two recorded stamps, the verification and the due date. R136: loads wherever the cohort has a start date.

metrics.label: Time on task
metrics.definition: Minutes from the first paste to the last verification of a task.
metrics.note: R132: a step has no start stamp; the first paste is the earliest fact.

metrics.label: Time to resolution
metrics.definition: Median minutes from the first paste to the verification per verified step with both stamps; over 24 hours counted apart.
metrics.note: R132: two recorded stamps; the median, so one long gap moves nothing.

metrics.label: Time against estimate
metrics.definition: Minutes from first paste to verification against the authored estimate of the task.
metrics.note: R132: computable from the same stamps; not wired this round.

metrics.label: Ranking
metrics.definition: Any ordering of members against each other.
metrics.note: Nothing is ranked.

metrics.label: Faults logged
metrics.definition: Fault, incident and triage rows the team filled on the forms of the role, over such rows the course expects.
metrics.note: A team fact; loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Faults resolved
metrics.definition: Fault, incident and triage rows whose outcome column reads resolved, over rows filled.
metrics.note: A team fact; loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Stuck flags cleared
metrics.definition: Stuck flags the member raised and later cleared, over flags raised.
metrics.note: R132: the flag history is append-only. R136: loads on every surface.

metrics.label: Decisions offered
metrics.definition: Decision blocks on the forms of the role, each with at least three options.

metrics.label: Decisions recorded
metrics.definition: Decision blocks with an option chosen by this member, over decision blocks on the forms of the role.
metrics.note: The choice carries who made it and when. Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Decisions justified
metrics.definition: Recorded decisions with every required supporting question answered, over decisions recorded.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Decisions approved
metrics.definition: Recorded decisions on a form the team approved or issued, over decisions recorded.
metrics.note: Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Reasons written
metrics.definition: Free-text rationale fields filled on the forms of the role, over such fields.
metrics.note: Team rows carry no author. Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Review marks met
metrics.definition: Instructor marks per rubric category that passed, over marks given on the forms of the role.
metrics.note: R132: one mark per category per verdict, kept as history. Loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Execution rows
metrics.definition: In order, first try, evidence named, checks met, control complete and on time, as rows of the Professional Execution domain.

metrics.label: Skills reused across courses
metrics.definition: Skills verified in two or more courses, over skills verified anywhere.
metrics.note: A portfolio fact: read across the member’s courses.

metrics.label: Professional tier
metrics.definition: Record items with ten or more verified uses across every course and retake, over items with any verified use.
metrics.note: R132: the threshold is ten; below it the item reads as building, with the count.

metrics.label: Cohort domain coverage
metrics.definition: Per cohort, members with at least one verified step per domain, over members. Instructor aggregate.

metrics.label: Funnel stages
metrics.definition: Members who reached each stage in turn, from enrolled to capstone filed, over members enrolled. Instructor aggregate.
metrics.note: Counts per cohort; nobody named.

metrics.label: Active weeks bands
metrics.definition: Members per band of graded weeks with any tick: none, one, two or three, four or more. Instructor aggregate.

metrics.label: Step friction
metrics.definition: Per verifiable step, members ticked without verification, stuck, or stopped before it, over members with the task.
metrics.note: Steps are ordered, never people.

metrics.label: Course verifiability
metrics.definition: Verifiable required steps over required steps per course. Content only.

metrics.label: Course skill coverage
metrics.definition: Skills, tools, procedures, standards, tactics and practices per course. Content only.

metrics.label: Cross-platform signal
metrics.definition: A competency-level statement shared with another platform.

metrics.label: Profile coverage
metrics.definition: Required competencies of a work role or an environment profile at verified or better, over required; the untaught remainder is named.

metrics.label: Skills proved twice
metrics.definition: Skills with verified steps on two or more distinct tasks, over skills with a verified step.

metrics.label: Skills current
metrics.definition: Skills whose last verification falls inside the currency window, over skills verified.
metrics.note: A window of days the page supplies; never a duration shown.

metrics.label: Capstone filed
metrics.definition: The course capstone document issued by the team, one per course, with the weeks cleared beside it.
metrics.note: A team fact; loads on the course page.

metrics.label: Ability estimate
metrics.definition: A latent ability per objective estimated from item responses on a practice platform.
metrics.note: The practice platform’s side; only a competency-level conclusion may cross, with consent.

metrics.label: Readiness band
metrics.definition: A pass-likelihood band per exam, validated against reported outcomes.
metrics.note: The practice platform’s side; needs reported outcomes and consent.

metrics.label: Transfer to unseen scenarios
metrics.definition: Verified work on a scenario never practised before, over such scenarios.
metrics.note: Needs scenario provenance per event.

metrics.label: Unassisted verifications
metrics.definition: Steps verified with no hint, tutor or agent assistance, over verified steps.
metrics.note: Needs the assist level recorded per event.

metrics.label: Rubric verdicts as events
metrics.definition: The four category verdicts of each frozen submission, appended as events.
metrics.note: The verdicts exist as rows today.

metrics.label: Placement reported
metrics.definition: Members who reported a role after a course, over members who answered with the outcome grant on.
metrics.note: Counts only, shown from five answers; the employer name stays with the member.

metrics.label: Used at work
metrics.definition: Members who reported using a course at work, over members who answered with the outcome grant on.
metrics.note: Self-reported by the member; an employer report needs a data agreement.

metrics.label: Platform return
metrics.definition: Cost per verified competency, and employer ramp saved, as the parties report them.
metrics.note: Needs cost and employer data nobody has handed in.

metrics.label: Time to competency
metrics.definition: Days from the first verification of a skill to its tenth verified use.
metrics.note: R132: the professional threshold is ten verified uses across courses.

metrics.label: Task time against benchmark
metrics.definition: Minutes to resolve a task against a published service-level baseline.
metrics.note: R132: no baseline is published yet.

metrics.label: Learning velocity
metrics.definition: Verified steps in the twenty-eight days before the page clock, over verified steps in the twenty-eight days before those.
metrics.note: R132: the page passes the clock; the projection reads none.

metrics.label: Values recalled
metrics.definition: Recall activities answered correctly, over recall activities answered, at the checkpoints reached.
metrics.note: R140: the activity asks for a value the team recorded; the distractors come from the record.

metrics.label: Scenarios applied
metrics.definition: Applied scenarios answered correctly, over applied scenarios offered at the checkpoints reached.
metrics.note: R140: an address inside the prefix, a free port on the host, the committed size doubled.

metrics.label: Conflicts resolved
metrics.definition: Conflicts the record found that are no longer present, over conflicts found, once the apply checkpoint is reached.
metrics.note: R140: read from the record itself; the answer only says the team looked.

metrics.label: Minutes on task
metrics.definition: Whole minutes the member had tasks open on a visible tab, pauses and hidden tabs excluded; a count.
metrics.note: R140: the timer the member can pause; measured, never rewarded.
